business_problem: IBM Consulting needed to help developers create and modernize Ansible automation faster because skilled developer capacity is constrained and legacy automation content is time-consuming to build, refactor, and validate by hand.
solution_summary: IBM Consulting used IBM watsonx Code Assistant for Red Hat Ansible Lightspeed to turn natural-language requests into higher-quality Ansible playbooks and modernization recommendations. The technical preview combined IBM and Red Hat work on a Granite foundation model trained and tuned on Ansible best practices, then surfaced suggestions with traceable source matches so developers could validate them before production use. IBM Consulting teams applied the assistant to new and legacy playbooks for installing SAP databases and applications on AWS, provisioning SQL and server components, and refactoring automations tied to user access management, security policy enforcement, and IBM WebSphere, MQ, and DB2 environments. Because the assistant produced recommended components rather than opaque code, it shortened the learning curve for newer automation developers while increasing the velocity and consistency of playbook creation. The implementation effectively added a generative-AI copilot to the IT-automation lifecycle without removing human review.
